measuredResult.authorityFix: ONE line. capabilities/index.ts:182 read `typography (ramp channels)`, which is prose: every walker splits on `.`, so it resolved to `typography["(ramp channels)"]` and landed the stop where nothing reads it. The real field is BrandTheme.typography.scale (themes/index.ts:568), handed to the posture lowering at brand-theme:774-791. Silent by construction, exactly like the `surfaces.density` anti-door: the seed at brand-theme:713 emits `--ds-type-scale: 1` unconditionally, so the arm never looked empty and only the stop-discrimination guard caught it. manifest ingress is derived from the registry (generator/index.mjs:246), so --sync propagated the fix and repinned the 20 registryDigests.
measuredResult.guardBeforeAfter: BEFORE: static-brand-theme THROWS "encodes NO stop" on rottay, bithire and evnto; DB PASS on all three. AFTER: static PASS with discriminating ["--ds-type-scale"] on all three; DB unchanged. 0/1 -> 1/1.
measuredResult.directChannel: Both arms, all three verticals: compacta -> 0.94 exact, amplia -> 1.06 exact. No per-vertical variation, and that is measured rather than assumed: NONE of the three verticals authors typography.scale (all three read undefined on their published baseline), so the baseline is the seed 1 everywhere.
measuredResult.identityStop: `normal` = 1 is the ramp identity and carries no receipt, like radius `suave` and density `normal`. Which of the two precedents it follows was MEASURED, not assumed: the DB arm ELIDES it (the delta is empty, so the arm emits none of the declared channels) while the static arm emits `1` because it compiles the whole theme. That is the radius shape, not the density one.

knownDefects.finding: THE INSTRUMENT READ STALE. Measured on the full 14-fixture roster through the probe own measure path: after an inline write on the document element the DEPENDENT computed properties came back ONE PHASE BEHIND -- the mutation read returned the baseline values, the removal read returned the mutation values -- while the custom property itself was always current. runtime/measure/index.mjs already documented this failure mode inside readAll; its offsetHeight flush plus a two-rAF settle was not sufficient at roster size. Evidence: packages/core/test-artifacts/quality-evidence/wo-cra-23/H3/isolation.MEASURED-NOT-RECEIPTED.json.
knownDefects.productionReading: DT ruling: this is not a priori a production defect. The productive DB path compiles on the server and embeds the artifact for SSR, and the client hydrates that exact artifact with visualAuthority=compiled-artifact -- so the served artifact carries the tenant RESOLVED values in the artifact scope itself and paints correctly. The probe DB arm models the PREVIEW path (provider-side emission, inline on html), which is the compatibility path. The gap is therefore in what the arm MODELS, and it will hit every control whose channel the artifact bakes into that scope, not only this one.
knownDefects.remediation: Packet H-3: make the probe DB arm apply its delta the way production serves it -- serving the compiled tenant artifact, or writing at the [data-ds-root] scope instead of inline on html; the exact form is H-3 design work, decided by measuring how SSR embeds the artifact. After H-3 this control re-runs and emits its R8 receipts. Registered as a sibling instance of OPEN_VERTICAL_CASCADE_DEFECT: same class, artifact outranking the DB arm position; the bithire dark double declaration is the other instance.
knownDefects.supersessionNote: SUPERSEDED, and the superseded entry was WRONG rather than incomplete. It claimed the vertical artifact shadowed the DB arm position because the channel is declared in the [data-ds-root] scope. Three measurements refute that: the probe scene puts data-tenant, data-ds-root and data-vertical on the SAME element (html), so there is no descendant to shadow anything; only three literal declarations of --ds-type-scale exist and all three sit at that root selector; and FOUR already-closed controls (density.mode, experience.profile, shape.radius-scale, surfaces.effect-intensity) declare their own channel in exactly that scope and closed with ingressEquivalence holding. The class does not exist. Chain of record, per AA-1: measured and written by the writer (Claude Opus) across F4B-7, the H-3 design and H-3a; adjudicated by the DT (Kimi K3), who ordered isolate-before-serve; endorsed by Fable in the H-3 preaudit (AA-1..AA-5).
knownDefects.fix: H-3a: readAll no longer trusts its first answer. It reads, provokes a full style invalidation, and reads again, accepting only after TWO consecutive identical readings, and throwing if the page never settles. Measured effect on this control, same serving model and no cascade change: light-scope divergence fell from 27 rows to 16, and card-modern-md/root now moves 15px -> 14.1px on the DB arm, byte-identical to the static arm. Invariance of the already-closed evidence was measured, not assumed: 36 stored scenarios re-run under the corrected instrument, 26212 shared movement keys compared, ZERO moved values and ZERO changed verdict legs.
knownDefects.residual: STILL OPEN, and narrower than before: 16 light-scope rows where the two arms SETTLE on different values rather than one arm lagging. The signature is a chain applied once versus twice -- card-modern-md/title reads 12.3375px on the DB arm (13.125 x 0.94, the dial applied ONCE) against 11.5972px on the static arm (13.125 x 0.94 squared, applied TWICE), with button-modern-md/hitbox showing the same shape on height/width -- plus THREE preset-gap roots (flex, grid, stack, across gap/column-gap/row-gap) the DB arm does not move at all. space-modern-preset-gap is NOT among them, which is part of the signature and is not explained. Hardening the stability law moved NONE of the sixteen (27 -> 16 -> 16), which is what rules out staleness as their cause. Unidentified, and deliberately NOT attributed to a mechanism this packet cannot show. Full row set, census and progression persisted at packages/core/test-artifacts/quality-evidence/wo-cra-23/H3/residual-divergence.MEASURED-NOT-RECEIPTED.json.
